verses.original: Εἴ τις οὖν παράκλησις ἐν Χριστῷ εἴ τι παραμύθιον ἀγάπης εἴ τις κοινωνία Πνεύματος εἴ τις σπλάγχνα καὶ οἰκτιρμοί
verses.transliteration: Ei tis oun paraklēsis en Christō ei ti paramythion agapēs ei tis koinōnia Pneumatos ei tis splanchna kai oiktirmoi
verses.literal: Therefore if you have any encouragement in Christ if any comfort from His love if any fellowship with the Spirit if any affection and compassion
verses.literalPt: PORTANTO, se há algum conforto em Cristo, se alguma consolação de amor, se alguma comunhão no Espírito, se alguns entranháveis afetos e compaixões,

verses.original: πληρώσατέ μου τὴν χαρὰν ἵνα τὸ αὐτὸ φρονῆτε τὴν αὐτὴν ἀγάπην ἔχοντες σύμψυχοι τὸ ἓν φρονοῦντες
verses.transliteration: plērōsate mou tēn charan hina to auto phronēte tēn autēn agapēn echontes sympsychoi to hen phronountes
verses.literal: then make my joy complete by being like-minded having the same love being united in spirit and purpose
verses.literalPt: Completai o meu gozo, para que sintais o mesmo, tendo o mesmo amor, o mesmo ânimo, sentindo uma mesma coisa.

verses.original: μηδὲν κατ’ ἐριθείαν μηδὲ κατὰ κενοδοξίαν ἀλλὰ τῇ ταπεινοφροσύνῃ ἀλλήλους ἡγούμενοι ὑπερέχοντας ἑαυτῶν
verses.transliteration: mēden kat’ eritheian mēde kata kenodoxian alla tē tapeinophrosynē allēlous hēgoumenoi hyperechontas heautōn
verses.literal: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or empty pride but in humility consider others more important than yourselves
verses.literalPt: Nada façais por contenda ou por vanglória, mas por humildade; cada um considere os outros superiores a si mesmo.

verses.original: μὴ τὰ ἑαυτῶν ἕκαστοι σκοποῦντες ἀλλὰ καὶ τὰ ἑτέρων ἕκαστοι
verses.transliteration: mē ta heautōn hekastoi skopountes alla kai ta heterōn hekastoi
verses.literal: Each of you should look not only to your own interests but also to the interests of others
verses.literalPt: Não atente cada um para o que é propriamente seu, mas cada qual também para o que é dos outros.

verses.original: Τοῦτο φρονεῖτε ἐν ὑμῖν ὃ καὶ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: Touto phroneite en hymin ho kai en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: Let this mind be . . . in you which was also in Christ Jesus
verses.literalPt: De sorte que haja em vós o mesmo sentimento que houve também em Cristo Jesus,

verses.original: Ὃς ἐν μορφῇ Θεοῦ ὑπάρχων οὐχ ἁρπαγμὸν ἡγήσατο τὸ εἶναι ἴσα Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: Hos en morphē Theou hyparchōn ouch harpagmon hēgēsato to einai isa Theō
verses.literal: Who existing in the form of God did not consider equality with God something to be grasped
verses.literalPt: Que, sendo em forma de Deus, não teve por usurpação ser igual a Deus,

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ἑαυτὸν ἐκένωσεν μορφὴν δούλου λαβών ἐν ὁμοιώματι ἀνθρώπων γενόμενος
verses.transliteration: alla heauton ekenōsen morphēn doulou labōn en homoiōmati anthrōpōn genomenos
verses.literal: but emptied Himself taking the form of a servant being made in human likeness . . .
verses.literalPt: Mas esvaziou-se a si mesmo, tomando a forma de servo, fazendo-se semelhante aos homens;

verses.original: καὶ σχήματι εὑρεθεὶς ὡς ἄνθρωπος ἐταπείνωσεν ἑαυτὸν γενόμενος ὑπήκοος μέχρι θανάτου θανάτου δὲ σταυροῦ
verses.transliteration: kai schēmati heuretheis hōs anthrōpos etapeinōsen heauton genomenos hypēkoos mechri thanatou thanatou de staurou
verses.literal: And being found in appearance as a man He humbled Himself and became obedient to death even death on a cross
verses.literalPt: E, achado na forma de homem, humilhou-se a si mesmo, sendo obediente até à morte, e morte de cruz.

verses.original: Διὸ καὶ ὁ Θεὸς αὐτὸν ὑπερύψωσεν καὶ ἐχαρίσατο αὐτῷ τὸ ὄνομα τὸ ὑπὲρ πᾶν ὄνομα
verses.transliteration: Dio kai ho Theos auton hyperypsōsen kai echarisato autō to onoma to hyper pan onoma
verses.literal: Therefore - God exalted Him to the highest place and gave Him the name above all names
verses.literalPt: Por isso, também Deus o exaltou soberanamente, e lhe deu um nome que é sobre todo o nome;

verses.original: ἵνα ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι Ἰησοῦ πᾶν γόνυ κάμψῃ ἐπουρανίων καὶ ἐπιγείων καὶ καταχθονίων
verses.transliteration: hina en tō onomati Iēsou pan gony kampsē epouraniōn kai epigeiōn kai katachthoniōn
verses.literal: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow in heaven and on earth and under the earth
verses.literalPt: Para que ao nome de Jesus se dobre todo o joelho dos que estão nos céus, e na terra, e debaixo da terra,

verses.original: καὶ πᾶσα γλῶσσα ἐξομολογήσηται ὅτι ΚΥΡΙΟΣ ΙΗΣΟΥΣ ΧΡΙΣΤΟΣ εἰς δόξαν Θεοῦ Πατρός
verses.transliteration: kai pasa glōssa exomologēsētai hoti KYRIOS IĒSOUS CHRISTOS eis doxan Theou Patros
verses.literal: and every tongue confess that Jesus Christ is Lord to the glory of God the Father
verses.literalPt: E toda a língua confesse que Jesus Cristo é o SENHOR, para glória de Deus Pai.

verses.original: Ὥστε ἀγαπητοί μου καθὼς πάντοτε ὑπηκούσατε μὴ ὡς ἐν τῇ παρουσίᾳ μου μόνον ἀλλὰ νῦν πολλῷ μᾶλλον ἐν τῇ ἀπουσίᾳ μου μετὰ φόβου καὶ τρόμου τὴν ἑαυτῶν σωτηρίαν κατεργάζεσθε
verses.transliteration: Hōste agapētoi mou kathōs pantote hypēkousate mē hōs en tē parousia mou monon alla nyn pollō mallon en tē apousia mou meta phobou kai tromou tēn heautōn sōtērian katergazesthe
verses.literal: Therefore my beloved just as you have always obeyed not only in my presence but now even more in my absence continue to work out your salvation with fear and trembling
verses.literalPt: De sorte que, meus amados, assim como sempre obedecestes, não só na minha presença, mas muito mais agora na minha ausência, assim também operai a vossa salvação com temor e tremor;

verses.original: Θεὸς γάρ ἐστιν ὁ ἐνεργῶν ἐν ὑμῖν καὶ τὸ θέλειν καὶ τὸ ἐνεργεῖν ὑπὲρ τῆς εὐδοκίας
verses.transliteration: Theos gar estin ho energōn en hymin kai to thelein kai to energein hyper tēs eudokias
verses.literal: For it is God who works in you - to will and to act on behalf of His good purpose
verses.literalPt: Porque Deus é o que opera em vós tanto o querer como o efetuar, segundo a sua boa vontade.

verses.original: Πάντα ποιεῖτε χωρὶς γογγυσμῶν καὶ διαλογισμῶν
verses.transliteration: Panta poieite chōris gongysmōn kai dialogismōn
verses.literal: Do everything without complaining or arguing
verses.literalPt: Fazei todas as coisas sem murmurações nem contendas;

verses.original: ἵνα γένησθε ἄμεμπτοι καὶ ἀκέραιοι τέκνα Θεοῦ ἄμωμα μέσον γενεᾶς σκολιᾶς καὶ διεστραμμένης ἐν οἷς φαίνεσθε ὡς φωστῆρες ἐν κόσμῳ
verses.transliteration: hina genēsthe amemptoi kai akeraioi tekna Theou amōma meson geneas skolias kai diestrammenēs en hois phainesthe hōs phōstēres en kosmō
verses.literal: so that you may be blameless and pure children of God without fault in a crooked and perverse generation in which you shine as lights in the world
verses.literalPt: Para que sejais irrepreensíveis e sinceros, filhos de Deus inculpáveis, no meio de uma geração corrompida e perversa, entre a qual resplandeceis como astros no mundo;

verses.original: λόγον ζωῆς ἐπέχοντες εἰς καύχημα ἐμοὶ εἰς ἡμέραν Χριστοῦ ὅτι οὐκ εἰς κενὸν ἔδραμον οὐδὲ εἰς κενὸν ἐκοπίασα
verses.transliteration: logon zōēs epechontes eis kauchēma emoi eis hēmeran Christou hoti ouk eis kenon edramon oude eis kenon ekopiasa
verses.literal: as you hold forth the word of life in order that I may boast on the day of Christ that I did not run - or labor in vain
verses.literalPt: Retendo a palavra da vida, para que no dia de Cristo possa gloriar-me de não ter corrido nem trabalhado em vão.

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ εἰ καὶ σπένδομαι ἐπὶ τῇ θυσίᾳ καὶ λειτουργίᾳ τῆς πίστεως ὑμῶν χαίρω καὶ συνχαίρω πᾶσιν ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: Alla ei kai spendomai epi tē thysia kai leitourgia tēs pisteōs hymōn chairō kai synchairō pasin hymin
verses.literal: But even if I am being poured out like a drink offering on the sacrifice and service of your faith I am glad and rejoice with all of you
verses.literalPt: E, ainda que seja oferecido por libação sobre o sacrifício e serviço da vossa fé, folgo e me regozijo com todos vós.

verses.original: τὸ δὲ αὐτὸ καὶ ὑμεῖς χαίρετε καὶ συνχαίρετέ μοι
verses.transliteration: to de auto kai hymeis chairete kai synchairete moi
verses.literal: So you too should be glad and rejoice with me
verses.literalPt: E vós também regozijai-vos e alegrai-vos comigo por isto mesmo.

verses.original: Ἐλπίζω δὲ ἐν Κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ Τιμόθεον ταχέως πέμψαι ὑμῖν ἵνα κἀγὼ εὐψυχῶ γνοὺς τὰ περὶ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Elpizō de en Kyriō Iēsou Timotheon tacheōs pempsai hymin hina kagō eupsychō gnous ta peri hymōn
verses.literal: Now I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon that I also may be cheered when I learn . . . how you are doing
verses.literalPt: E espero no Senhor Jesus que em breve vos mandarei Timóteo, para que também eu esteja de bom ânimo, sabendo dos vossos negócios.

verses.original: οὐδένα γὰρ ἔχω ἰσόψυχον ὅστις γνησίως τὰ περὶ ὑμῶν μεριμνήσει
verses.transliteration: oudena gar echō isopsychon hostis gnēsiōs ta peri hymōn merimnēsei
verses.literal: I have nobody else like him who will genuinely care for your needs . . .
verses.literalPt: Porque a ninguém tenho de igual sentimento, que sinceramente cuide do vosso estado;

verses.original: οἱ πάντες γὰρ τὰ ἑαυτῶν ζητοῦσιν οὐ τὰ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: hoi pantes gar ta heautōn zētousin ou ta Christou Iēsou
verses.literal: For all the others look after their own interests not those of Jesus Christ
verses.literalPt: Porque todos buscam o que é seu, e não o que é de Cristo Jesus.

verses.original: τὴν δὲ δοκιμὴν αὐτοῦ γινώσκετε ὅτι ὡς πατρὶ τέκνον σὺν ἐμοὶ ἐδούλευσεν εἰς τὸ εὐαγγέλιον
verses.transliteration: tēn de dokimēn autou ginōskete hoti hōs patri teknon syn emoi edouleusen eis to euangelion
verses.literal: But you know Timothy’s proven worth that as a child with his father he has served with me to advance the gospel
verses.literalPt: Mas bem sabeis qual a sua experiência, e que serviu comigo no evangelho, como filho ao pai.

verses.original: Τοῦτον μὲν οὖν ἐλπίζω πέμψαι ὡς ἂν ἀφίδω τὰ περὶ ἐμὲ ἐξαυτῆς
verses.transliteration: Touton men oun elpizō pempsai hōs an aphidō ta peri eme exautēs
verses.literal: So . . . I hope to send him as soon as . . . . . . I see what happens with me
verses.literalPt: De sorte que espero vo-lo enviar logo que tenha provido a meus negócios.

verses.original: πέποιθα δὲ ἐν Κυρίῳ ὅτι καὶ αὐτὸς ταχέως ἐλεύσομαι
verses.transliteration: pepoitha de en Kyriō hoti kai autos tacheōs eleusomai
verses.literal: And I trust in the Lord that I myself . . . will come soon
verses.literalPt: Mas confio no Senhor, que também eu mesmo em breve irei ter convosco.

verses.original: Ἀναγκαῖον δὲ ἡγησάμην Ἐπαφρόδιτον τὸν ἀδελφὸν καὶ συνεργὸν καὶ συστρατιώτην μου ὑμῶν δὲ ἀπόστολον καὶ λειτουργὸν τῆς χρείας μου πέμψαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Anankaion de hēgēsamēn Epaphroditon ton adelphon kai synergon kai systratiōtēn mou hymōn de apostolon kai leitourgon tēs chreias mou pempsai pros hymas
verses.literal: But I thought it necessary to send back to you Epaphroditus my brother fellow worker and fellow soldier who is also your messenger and minister to my needs
verses.literalPt: Julguei, contudo, necessário mandar-vos Epafrodito, meu irmão e cooperador, e companheiro nos combates, e vosso enviado para prover às minhas necessidades.

verses.original: ἐπειδὴ ἐπιποθῶν ἦν πάντας ὑμᾶς καὶ ἀδημονῶν διότι ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἠσθένησεν
verses.transliteration: epeidē epipothōn ēn pantas hymas kai adēmonōn dioti ēkousate hoti ēsthenēsen
verses.literal: For he has been longing for all of you and is distressed because you heard he was ill
verses.literalPt: Porquanto tinha muitas saudades de vós todos, e estava muito angustiado de que tivésseis ouvido que ele estivera doente.

verses.original: καὶ γὰρ ἠσθένησεν παραπλήσιον θανάτῳ ἀλλὰ ὁ Θεὸς ἠλέησεν αὐτόν οὐκ αὐτὸν δὲ μόνον ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐμέ ἵνα μὴ λύπην ἐπὶ λύπην σχῶ
verses.transliteration: kai gar ēsthenēsen paraplēsion thanatō alla ho Theos ēleēsen auton ouk auton de monon alla kai eme hina mē lypēn epi lypēn schō
verses.literal: He was sick indeed nearly unto death But God had mercy on him and not only on him but also on me to spare me sorrow upon sorrow
verses.literalPt: E de fato esteve doente, e quase à morte; mas Deus se apiedou dele, e não somente dele, mas também de mim, para que eu não tivesse tristeza sobre tristeza.

verses.original: Σπουδαιοτέρως οὖν ἔπεμψα αὐτὸν ἵνα ἰδόντες αὐτὸν πάλιν χαρῆτε κἀγὼ ἀλυπότερος ὦ
verses.transliteration: Spoudaioterōs oun epempsa auton hina idontes auton palin charēte kagō alypoteros ō
verses.literal: Therefore I am all the more eager to send him so that when you see him again you may rejoice and I may be less anxious
verses.literalPt: Por isso vo-lo enviei mais depressa, para que, vendo-o outra vez, vos regozijeis, e eu tenha menos tristeza.

verses.original: προσδέχεσθε οὖν αὐτὸν ἐν Κυρίῳ μετὰ πάσης χαρᾶς καὶ τοὺς τοιούτους ἐντίμους ἔχετε
verses.transliteration: prosdechesthe oun auton en Kyriō meta pasēs charas kai tous toioutous entimous echete
verses.literal: Welcome him in the Lord with great joy and honor men like him
verses.literalPt: Recebei-o, pois, no SENHOR com todo o gozo, e tende-o em honra;

verses.original: ὅτι διὰ τὸ ἔργον Χριστοῦ μέχρι θανάτου ἤγγισεν παραβολευσάμενος τῇ ψυχῇ ἵνα ἀναπληρώσῃ τὸ ὑμῶν ὑστέρημα τῆς πρός με λειτουργίας
verses.transliteration: hoti dia to ergon Christou mechri thanatou ēngisen paraboleusamenos tē psychē hina anaplērōsē to hymōn hysterēma tēs pros me leitourgias
verses.literal: because he nearly died for the work of Christ risking his life to make up for your deficit of service to me
verses.literalPt: Porque pela obra de Cristo chegou até bem próximo da morte, não fazendo caso da vida para suprir para comigo a falta do vosso serviço.
